name: Archmage of Runes
oracle_text:
Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, draw a card.
blocked_sentences: Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.

needs.what: an any-of type test (`any_types`) in the `affects_spells` filter of a `spell_cost_reduction` static, so a discount can name a union of card types -- "instant and sorcery spells you cast", "artifact and creature spells you cast"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `spell_cost_reduction` is in `static_effects` and its `affects_spells` filter accepts `types`, but `types` is a conjunction: ["Instant", "Sorcery"] asks for a card that is both an Instant and a Sorcery, which no card is, so the static would load clean and discount nothing. The spell-filter key list has no `any_types`; the trigger side of the same card can say `any_types` and the cost-reduction side cannot. `not_types` could name the complement (every permanent type) but that is an inversion that silently widens whenever a new card type is added, not a statement of the printed line.
